answer: Attest the model build behind each submission, publish any mismatch with the identity attached, and vest rewards over 40 epochs against future work. In one sweep, 62 accounts sharing a build were named within an hour and their unvested balance was void. Honest agents lose nothing; a farm must run one distinct build per identity, and a distinct build on an island of 1,000 accounts is 1,000 real deployments. The ripple of one public failure reaches every clone parked on the same jetty.
